inv_01_maintained_cryptography_library.detail: Ed25519 signing and verification implemented using cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 (version 50.0.1).

inv_02_zero_custom_fallback.detail: ZERO_CUSTOM_FALLBACK = True enforced. Pure-Python math routines removed; operations fail closed if cryptography is missing.

inv_03_test_key_isolation.detail: KNOWN_TEST_SEEDS denylist blocks deterministic test seeds from production enrollment or usage.

inv_04_authoritative_registry_roles.detail: Operator roles derived strictly from immutable TrustedOperatorIdentityRegistry records.

inv_05_caller_role_conveys_zero_privileg.detail: CLI parameter --approver-role has no authoritative effect; caller authority is validated solely against Ed25519 signature.

inv_06_approval_signature_digest_binding.detail: Approval intent binds exact canonical request digest and domain separation prefix (CBE-ED25519-APPROVAL-INTENT-V1:).

inv_07_single_use_nonces.detail: Nonces tracked atomically in SQLite approval_nonces; replay attempts rejected with REPLAY_ATTACK_DETECTED_NONCE_ALREADY_USED.

inv_08_hmac_capability_tokens_independen.detail: Layer B HMAC-SHA256 capability tokens require valid Layer A Ed25519 signed intent before issuance.

inv_09_governance_freeze_active.detail: is_production=True strictly prohibited; raises AuthorizationError with governance violation message.

inv_10_external_network_requests_disable.detail: NetworkActivationGate fail-closed; zero external HTTP requests performed during execution.

inv_11_market_observation_disabled.detail: Prospective market observation runner inactive; no live exchange connections.

inv_12_live_trading_prohibited.detail: LIVE_ORDER_EXECUTION capability permanently blocked with TradingIsolationViolation.
